statement.p: Find the exact solution to the equation below. (Do not give a decimal approximation.)

static.solution:
SOLUTION
First we isolate the exponent: 56 e^{5 x + 2} = 24 so that e^{5 x + 2} = \frac{24}{56}. Once the exponent isolated we use logs and solve for x: \begin{aligned} \ln{ \left( e^{5 x + 2} \right) } \amp = \ln{(24/56)} \\ 5 x + 2 \amp = \ln{(24/56)} \\ 5 x \amp = \ln{(24/56)} - 2 \\ x \amp = \frac{ \ln{(24/56)} - 2}{5}. \end{aligned}
